query:
-- Fences
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scenic design, Fences, August Wilson, Maples Repertory Theatre, realistic interior, 1950s'
WHERE slug = 'fences';

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'fences'
AND t.name IN ('1950s', 'Realistic Interior', 'Regional Theatre', '2023', 'Contemporary Drama', 'August Wilson');
